context.goal: Sign on to the teller console, look up member {{member_id}}, open a new {{product}} sub-account funded with an initial deposit of {{initial_deposit}} from the member's Share Savings (suffix S01), confirm it, and read the confirmation number.
recent_actions: 6. click button "Search" — ok (Submit the member search to look up the member.)
7. click link "Open Sub-Account" — ok (Open the sub-account creation form for this member.)
8. select combobox "Product:" = {{product}} — ok (Choose the requested sub-account product.)
9. fill textbox "Initial Deposit:" = {{initial_deposit}} — ok (Enter the initial deposit amount.)
10. click button "Continue" — ok (Product, deposit, and funding suffix S01 are set; continue to the confirmation step.)
